answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The meadow holds work receipts rather than names, so the lagoon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on liquidity provision incentives with impermanent loss hedging. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a pragmatic engineering perspective, trade-offs first register, it stays short.
